lines.text: Did you know? Duc is Latin for lead.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus lead?

words.ex: Higher wages could induce more people to become teachers.
Education is the key to a better future.

publish.title: Duc root: induce and education
publish.value: Duc comes from Latin "ducere" (to lead). Words: induce and education. induce = in + duce; education = e + duc.
